description_en: Queries the registration and running status of a user-side Agent by agent type and skill name to determine whether the local environment is ready
description_zh: 按 Agent 类型与 Skill 名称查询用户侧 Agent 的注册与运行状态，用于判断本地环境是否就绪
name: GetLhmAgentStatus

parameters.help_en:
The Agent type. Valid values:
0: data validation (the only type currently supported).
1: metadata
parameters.help_zh: Agent 类型：0-数据校验（当前只有这一种），1-元数据
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The skill name. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: skill_name

data.description_en: The business data returned by the operation as a string. The content varies depending on the operation
data.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据（字符串形式），具体内容随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues with the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Use errCode and errMessage to troubleshoot the issue
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
